investmentTheses.summary: Partnering with outlier founders building foundational AI architectures, intelligence-native applications, and resilient enterprise SaaS engines.
evaluationCriteria: Founding Team Exceptionalism: Founders with rare technical depth, clarity of thought, and relentless customer empathy
Inflection Points: Capitalizing on macro technology shifts (AI platform transitions, enterprise cloud architecture)
Product-Led Moats: Structural data flywheels, compounding distribution advantages, and durable unit economics
Target Ownership: 15-20% ownership at early rounds with long-term partnership commitment
requiredTraction: Seed to Series A: Obsessive organic customer retention, rapid product iterations, and early enterprise pilot conversions
Series B: Compounding ARR growth exceeding 3x YoY with world-class net dollar retention (>130%)
avoids: Incremental point tools easily replicated by incumbent platform giants
Teams lacking deep in-house engineering and machine learning capabilities

investmentTheses.summary: Funding ambitious, hard technology breakthroughs in defense, aerospace, robotics, and energy that conventional venture capital deems too risky or capital intensive.
evaluationCriteria: Audacious Technological Ambition: Projects solving critical engineering challenges in aerospace, energy, robotics, and defense
Technological Monopoly Potential: Proprietary 10x architectural breakthroughs that prevent easy commoditization
Contrarian Thesis: Backing ideas and paradigms that the mainstream venture consensus overlooks
Mission-Driven Founders: Tenacious technical leadership with unrelenting conviction
requiredTraction: Demonstrated physics or engineering feasibility at prototype stage
Validated milestone roadmap or non-dilutive defense/commercial pre-orders
avoids: Copycat consumer social apps and derivative ad-supported models
Regulatory arbitrage businesses lacking hard technological moats

investmentTheses.summary: Transforming Canadian tech category leaders into enduring global sovereign champions across foundational AI, fintech, and digital health.
evaluationCriteria: Canadian Anchor with Global Ambition: Headquartered in Canada with proven ability to dominate US and international markets
Scale-Up Readiness: $10M+ ARR scaling toward $100M+ ARR with disciplined capital allocation
Enterprise Network Effects: High switching costs, expanding Annual Contract Value (ACV), and gross margin >80%
Executive Leadership: Seasoned executive management teams capable of global multi-jurisdiction execution
requiredTraction: $10M+ ARR for Growth Stage with >50% YoY organic expansion
Tier-1 international customer references across North America and Europe
avoids: Businesses unable or unwilling to expand outside the Canadian domestic market
Cap tables without clear governance alignment for long-term scale-up

investmentTheses.summary: Investing in foundational AI, deep technology, and applied machine learning architectures built by elite technical teams solving global enterprise problems.
evaluationCriteria: Proprietary technical breakthrough or deep technical moat (research-backed AI architecture)
Elite technical founders (Vector, Waterloo, Toronto, Stanford alumni)
Massive global addressable market ($10B+ TAM)
Clear pathway to defensible data flywheels and compounding accuracy
High capital efficiency relative to compute demands
requiredTraction: Working prototype or live enterprise pilot with validation
Demonstrated benchmark superiority over open/commercial baselines
Leading technical research publications or issued IP
avoids: Thin wrappers on third-party foundation models without defensibility
Pure consumer lifestyle applications lacking proprietary data

investmentTheses.summary: High-conviction, early-stage lead investor backing visionary founders solving acute enterprise and financial workflow frictions.

15-20% target initial equity ownership

Pilot conversions into commercial multi-year contracts
